//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Enchantment Level Cap Indicator -> Config

Enable Enchantment Level Cap Indicator.//: Whether Enchantment Level Cap Indicator is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart. Do not disable a mod that adds blocks or items to an existing world, they will be removed.

maxLevelSymbol.//: The symbol used to show that an enchantment is the maximum level. By default a star.

maxLevelSymbolColourIndex.//: The colour index value used for the max level symbol. Possible values; 0: black, 1: dark_blue, 2: dark_green, 3: dark_aqua, 4: dark_red, 5: dark_purple, 6: gold, 7: gray, 8: dark_gray, 9: blue, 10: green, 11: aqua, 12: red, 13: light_purple, 14: yellow, 15: white min: 0, max: 15

showSymbolInItemTooltip.//: Whether the max level symbol should be shown in the tooltip when hovering over an item.

showSymbolInEnchantmentTable.//: Whether the max level should be shown when hovering over potential enchantments in the enchantment table.
